facts.fact: Banco de Moçambique states the new SIMORede platform offers interoperability (interconnection) between MNOs, banks and other financial service providers, with all banks and MNOs integrated since 19 November 2023.

Banco de Moçambique states all commercial banks and mobile network operators have been fully integrated into the National Switch and operate exclusively on the Euronet-provided SIMORede platform since 19 November 2023.
